BLOCK5.html: GraphRAG Is Useful When the Question Is About Relationships, Not Similarity

BLOCK6.html: Vector retrieval is excellent when the answer lives near semantically similar text. Graph-oriented retrieval earns its cost when the answer depends on relationships, communities, or evidence spread across multiple parts of a corpus.

BLOCK8.html: Voice AI Latency Is a Waterfall, Not One Number

BLOCK9.html: A voice agent can report fast STT, fast LLM, and fast TTS while still feeling slow because endpointing, network boundaries, tool calls, buffering, and playout delays accumulate between those component timers.
